title: AI Imagery and the Overton Window

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and citation of external prompt-based tests (e.g., Python code generation tasks) demonstrating racial profiling and stereotypes in AI text and image generation models.
Literature review referencing examples of AI models systematically favoring specific genders in contexts like automated hiring, driven by historical dataset imbalances.
Literature review discussing how AI text-to-image generators produce formulaic images that lean towards specific cultural stereotypes.
